en: Right now, war is about to break out between Tojo and Omi.
Daigo told me the seventh Omi chairman isn't long for this world. And those two are the ones who made the peace agreement.
Exactly. If the seventh chairman dies, war between the east and west is pretty much guaranteed.
That's why some of the high-ranking Tojo guys went around drumming up support. They went to Fukuoka, Sapporo, and Nagoya, and talked to the local yakuza there.
Lieutenant Azumi went to Nagoya, Majima-san took Sapporo, and Chairman Dojima went to Fukuoka.
But then Daigo went missing in Fukuoka...
Because of the betrayal... by Aoyama and Morinaga.
Right. Their original plan was for Chairman Dojima to be executed, along with Madarame, the head of the Yamagasa Family.
But that plan failed. And after Chairman Dojima and Madarame both escaped, Aoyama-san shifted gears.
He had some ideas of his own?
Oh, yeah. With Chairman Dojima missing, he tried to take over the Tojo.
But taking over was never the real mission that Aoyama-san and Morinaga were tasked with.
Quite the opposite. The real mission was to sell out the Tojo.
Sell it out? Hm. I think I can guess who the buyer was.
Yep. The Omi Alliance.
Aoyama and Morinaga were in bed with the Omi all along.
Damn those guys...
They had two objectives.
The first was to assassinate the Tojo leadership, like Chairman Dojima and Majima-san. The other objective was⑬
Me.
Yes. They were going to monitor former members, like you and Saejima-san, and lure you back to Tokyo.
Once you arrived, the next step was to do you in, of course.
But why make Tokyo their killing floor?
They didn't need to do it here. In fact, it would've been easier to deal with everyone separately.
No, it did have to be here. As far as the Omi Alliance is concerned, the Tojo Clan is built upon two legendary yakuza guys.
Kazuma Kiryu and Taiga Saejima. The Dragon of Dojima, and the slayer of eighteen.
Removing the two of you would bring the Tojo Clan to its knees.
By killing us both in Tokyo, they thought the whole clan would just be theirs for the taking.
Yes, but not to exterminate it⑬to lead it.
Do you see? They wanted more than Tojo turf. They wanted Tojo soldiers.
All 30,000. That's why they wanted to avoid an all-out war.
Why kill their own future recruits?
Is Saejima already on his way to Tokyo?
Probably. I was with him up until we broke out of prison.
Sounds like you know each other pretty well. You two become close friends or something?
Well. You tend to bond when you do time together. Of course, I was planted there as part of the plan.
I was under the orders of the Omi Alliance, just like Aoyama and Morinaga.
My role was to break Saejima-san out of prison, and make sure he was motivated to investigate Majima-san's death.
After the break-out, things were going according to plan. But somewhere along the way, I... Um, I...
Saejima won you over, huh?
...By the time we split up, I felt like I'd follow him anywhere.
That's why I'm here, talking to you and spilling the beans.
But whose beans are they?
You say Omi is behind it, but their captain Watase didn't seem to know anything.
To understand that, you have to know what's happening on the Omi side of things.
I know that the factions are vying for the top spot.
Okay, then. Moving on...
After hearing that the seventh chairman was about to die, three families in the alliance began maneuvering for the throne.
The Watase Family, led by Captain Masaru Watase, is based in northern Osaka. They have the most muscle.
Lieutenant Hiroshi Takachi has his power base in Hyogo, and the seventh chairman trusts him greatly.
And Naoki Katsuya heads Ousaka Enterprises, which has built an empire out of industrial waste disposal in southern Osaka.
Of the three, Watase is supposed to be the most likely successor.
And yet, Watase isn't the type to get his hands dirty like this.
Meanwhile, Takachi died in Nagoya. That only leaves one person.
Yes. The guy behind all of this, who hired me, Aoyama, and Morinaga... That guy is⑬
(Nobody's here. Maybe they're not open yet.)
(Place hasn't changed a bit. <Color:7>The Florist's Residence<Color:Default> should be over the bridge.)
It's been a long time, Saejima.
The Florist of Sai. You're lookin' well.
I heard that you got yourself into yet another snafu. Alas.
It wasn't enough to break out of Okinawa? Had to escape Abashiri, too?
I see nothin' gets past ya.
Bet ya even know why I'm here.
I'd venture to say it has something to do with the yakuza conflicts flaring up all over the country.
And I presume <Italic>you</Italic> would like to know why Goro Majima is six feet under.
Am I right?
Yeah, ya saved us both a lotta time. And I'm in a hurry⑬I already got a lead on the culprit.
Oh, is that so?
Lookin' for a guy named Morinaga. He was Daigo's bodyguard in the Tojo.
Morinaga, huh?
Word on the street is he showed up in Kamurocho a few days ago, then went straight inta hidin'.
I wanna know where he's at.
Don't worry⑬I'll pay ya a fair price.
Heh. Funny that you're asking about him.
I had another visitor earlier today... He also wanted to know where Morinaga was.
What!? ...Who?
Normally, I wouldn't tell you.
But it's your lucky day. I'm willing to make an exception.
You know the <Color:7>Underground Coliseum<Color:Default>? Head on over there.
(The <Color:7>Underground Coliseum<Color:Default>? That's in Purgatory.)
So that's what happened.
Yeah. Never imagined I'd be cast aside by Morinaga-aniki.
I mean... how could he do this to me? I'm his sworn brother!
And then concocting this traitorous plan... after protecting Chairman Dojima for so long.
Really? He never said a word to you 'bout what he was plannin'?
Not one fucking word. After he got shot by Aoyama at Yamagasa headquarters, I took him to the hospital, just like Kiryu-san told me to.
He was in critical condition and scheduled for surgery. But when I showed up the next day, he was gone.
He'd left a note for me.
Yeah. And it hardly even said anything. It just said, "Get away. Go back to Tokyo." I was confused as hell.
I wandered around Fukuoka looking for him. And then the next day, I heard Aoyama was dead.
Shot by Morinaga, no less.
That's when I knew he'd abandoned me. And everything we stood for.
We were so tight... even at the beginning, when we had nothing. We worked our way up together. I just don't get it.
Is that why you're lookin' for 'im? Wanna know why he turned his back on ya?
Yes... But now I'll never know.
That information broker agreed to tell me only if I won my fight.
But then he said he couldn't trust a guy who's willing to kill in the ring.
It's all messed up... Just like this shit with Morinaga-aniki. I don't know what to do, or think, anymore.
It's fucked up.
Hm? You all right, man?
No. It's fucked up.
The bond between sworn brothers is sacred. It ain't like some piddlin' schoolboy shit.
Yeah. What, you think I don't know that?
Aizawa's yer name, right?
Still got some fight left in ya?
Look at this guy.
*huff* *huff*
Who the hell is he?
His name's Aizawa. Another bodyguard for Daigo Dojima. Plus, he was Morinaga's man.
Morinaga's man?
What's with all the cash?
It's for you, if you agree to my proposal.
300 million yen to cover what you loaned to Park-san, plus an extra 200 million for your trouble.
500 mil, huh? That much for pulling out of a concert at the Japan Dome?
That's right. Haruka Sawamura's debut, scheduled for the day after tomorrow...
Just make sure it's dead.
It'll be easy. I already spoke with the event organizer.
You won't have to worry about ticket cancellation fees or anything.
Osaka Talent will cover it all.
So all this money will go directly to us?
Yes, to spend as you see fit. But if you're at a loss for ideas...
There's always Haruka Sawamura's future living expenses to consider.
And why do you think she'll need the money?
Well, bowing out of this concert won't exactly earn her a good reputation in the industry.
Nobody will want to work with the girl who couldn't handle her first big chance. She'll have to give up on her career.
Such lengths... just to crush a teenage girl's dreams?
That's not why I'm doing this. I just don't want her to play a concert there right now.
If she gets up on that stage, she might... Well...
Never mind. This is simply a business transaction.
It's a strategic move to stop her from gaining ground on our preferred idols, T-Set. That group is our most promising act.
There will still be a concert. But T-Set will perform in Haruka's place.
Just imagine the fanfare when Osaka Talent's best young idols make their debut at the Dome. It's great marketing.
Was that a yes? Are you accepting my offer?
You're a strange one, Katsuya-san.
The more I hear you talk, the less I understand you.
You're a good actor, though. One of the best I've seen.
But I still don't see you as the bad guy you make yourself out to be.
Oh, really? So all the nefarious things I've done in Osaka⑬they strike you as not that bad?
Oh, they strike me as vile. But it still seems like the real monster is Kanai⑬he was the one pulling the strings.
In fact, he was acting by himself, wasn't he?
When I first met you in your office at Osaka Talent, we talked about Park-san.
Even now, I still remember the look you had on your face.
What look?
A look of real emotion⑬a crack in the facade of an actor who's played a thousand roles.
See, I expected you to <Italic>pretend</Italic> to be sad. But you seemed genuinely sad. And angry.
I have to admit, it made me very curious about you, Katsuya-san.
Enough stalling. What is your answer?
I refuse. Obviously. It was Park-san's dream for Haruka to perform at the Dome.
For the sake of a dead woman you're willing to make an enemy out of us? Not just Osaka Talent, but all of Ousaka Enterprises?
Without hesitation.
Be seeing you, then.
Okay, so the Kuroha Family was in league with the Nagoya Family. They rigged games with the Wyverns and the Gigants player Sawada...
Man... I didn't expect to hear Daigo Dojima's name associated with any of this.
I was surprised that you even knew Dojima-kun.
Small world, huh? Then again, we do run in the same circles.
All right, you've convinced me. I'll help you out. But first...
Why stop the show? You said something about lives in danger?
Uh... I don't really know the details, to be honest. But Sawada said the Kuroha were going to pull something at the concert.
Sawada the Gigants pitcher?
Yeah. He was in line to take over the Nagoya, so he's wise to Kuroha plans.
You're sure his info is reliable? And you do realize we can't do anything if we don't know their plan?
My guess is a bomb.
Maybe. Have you told the police?
Several times. They don't believe my story.
Of course not. You don't have any evidence.
That's why the only way to stop them is to cancel the concert!
And you want 300 million to pay the cancellation fee. Man, first Katsuya, now you. Everyone wants this show canceled!
Oh, you mean Katsuya of Ousaka Enterprises?
Yeah. Funny thing is, both Kuroha and Ousaka are Omi Alliance. So why is one planning to do something at the concert, and the other is trying to shut it down?
Infighting, you think? But why?
Some kind of struggle over the leadership change.
The current chairman is Kuroha, but apparently he's gonna be out of the picture any day now.
Kuroha might be trying to consolidate power before the chairman bites the big one, and maybe Katsuya wants to stop them so that he himself can take over.
Makes sense.
It's still just conjecture. But now I get why you wanna stop the concert. So...
What's your plan for that 20 mil you said could wait until later? It better not be more debt, man. You should've paid that all off when you got the reward from Dojima-san.
I don't want to do that.
Dojima-kun's already given me another crack at my dream. That's more than enough reward.
I never should have taken the twenty million yen.
Wait, so you wanna go into debt again so you can return the 20 mil to Dojima-san? That's stupid!
No need to insult me...
Tch, well, I guess your heart's in the right place.
I knew there was something odd about that sum. Anyway...
I get the picture now.
Yeah, I wouldn't be surprised if all these events were linked somehow.
Me neither.
There's just one problem.
